metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.5 · 2014 · John Wick
metas.description: John Wick is a former hitman grieving the loss of his true love. When his home is broken into, robbed, and his dog killed, he is forced to return to action to exact revenge.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 7.4 · 2017 · John Wick: Chapter 2
metas.description: After returning to the criminal underworld to repay a debt, John Wick discovers that a large bounty has been put on his life.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 7.4 · 2019 · John Wick: Chapter 3 - Parabellum
metas.description: John Wick is on the run after killing a member of the international assassins' guild, and with a $14 million price tag on his head, he is the target of hit men and women everywhere.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 7.6 · 2023 · John Wick: Chapter 4
metas.description: John Wick uncovers a path to defeating The High Table. But before he can earn his freedom, Wick must face off against a new enemy with powerful alliances across the globe and forces that turn old friends into foes.
